# TrackUp — Personal Life OS

> Track your life. Build a better you. The unified personal operating system for tasks, habits, projects, and intentional living.

TrackUp is a high-performance personal operating system designed to bring calm and clarity to daily execution. It consolidates task management, multi-week project planning, habit streaks, strategic goal tracking, and personal progress analytics into a single cohesive interface.

## Core Capabilities
- Tasks: Fast capture, priority tiers (Low, Medium, High), due dates, and virtual views for Today, Upcoming, and Overdue.
- Projects: Structured workspaces to organize tasks, track milestones, and visualize project velocity.
- Goals: Strategic milestone tracking connecting long-term aspirations directly to day-to-day execution.
- Habits: Atomic habit tracking with streak counters and consistency monitoring.
- Analytics: Unified personal insights, completion velocity, and productivity trends.
- Expenses & Savings: Personal finance budgeting and savings goal tracking.
